verdict.rationale: Tavily is a web-search and extraction API for agents. Scheduled or background automations, such as recurring searches or monitors, are a plausible capability for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows on-demand API, SDK, CLI and MCP calls, plus an asynchronous Research task polled by request ID. That async task is a developer building block, not a user-configurable automation that runs autonomously, so it earns no credit.
